I)

Removed, refurbished and re-installed interior furnishings as outlined below:

2)

Replaced the existing crew seat dress covers with Teddy & Arthur Edelman OLD-B3 Old Shrunken Buffalo Bull Leather, lot KA06FL and
Aeristo Aerolamb Camel sheepskin, lot Y6M343. Attached Skandia, Inc. F.A.A./D.E.R. approved 8110-3, dated 01/24/07, work order

Certification / Packing list dated 01/19/07, to color coordinate. Each belt is tagged and identified as meeting FAA-TSO-C114, -C22F, or C22G requirements.

3)

Replaced the existing veneer on the entrance bulkheads with Carl F. Booth & Co. Elm Burl Veneer. Attached Skandia, Inc., F.A.A./D.E.R.
approved 8110-3, dated 02/13/07, work order 156511-07, document ID 75004, test ID 60NW-6004, DERY-405020-CE.

4)

Fireblocked and upholstered six (6) single cabin chairs, one (1) double seat, one (1) jumpseat, and potty seat with Teddy & Arthur Edelman
OLD-B3 Old Shrunken Buffalo Bull Leather, lot KA06FL. Aircraft seat cushions have been fireblocked as per the requirements of 14 CFR,
25.853(c) Amendment 25 — 116 Appendix F Part II. Results of sample burn tests are documented on attached Skandia Inc. FAA/D.E.R.
approved 8110-3, dated 02/09/07, work order 156074-07, document ID 74969, test plan 15724, DERY-410100-CE. Seatbelts were rewebbed by A.B.I. Attached SC-108B Certification / Packing list dated 01/19/07, to color coordinate. Each belt is tagged and identified as
meeting FAA-TSO-C114, -C22F, or -C22G requirements.
